cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: A Necessary Heartbreak
cards.instruction: Describe disappointment, rejection, or loss as the exact experience everyone needed in order to grow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That rejected contract will finally teach you what I couldn't: don't hang the whole bakery on one customer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can say 'needed' in the past tense now. Progress. I kept telling you to spread the risk.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can't pay the mixer loan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you'll learn the hand-kneading I could never get you to practise. Put your rings away. This may be the making of you.

reason: Use familiar training and pupil corrections as the method of the exact emotional pursuit; preserve partner contribution, acknowledge real responsibility, and avoid claiming every setback was a planned lesson.
